# rubrik_data_security_policy (Data Source)

The `rubrik_data_security_policy` data source is used to access information
about a data security policy in RSC. A data security policy is looked up using
either the policy ID or the name.

The filter is returned as the `object_filter` and `identity_filter` blocks, the
same shape the `rubrik_data_security_policy` resource uses. Predefined policies,
and policies created before RSC started enforcing that shape, are exempt from it
and can hold filters the two blocks cannot express. Looking up such a policy
fails with an error describing why.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Data security policy looked up by name.
data "rubrik_data_security_policy" "by_name" {
  name = "Overexposed Sensitive Data"
}

# Data security policy looked up by ID.
data "rubrik_data_security_policy" "by_id" {
  policy_id = "6ba9c3a1-2f4e-4d5c-9b1a-8e7f0d2c4a63"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the data security policy.
- `policy_id` (String) Data security policy ID (UUID).

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) Category of the data security policy.
- `description` (String) Description of the data security policy.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the data security policy is enabled.
- `id` (String) Data security policy ID (UUID).
- `identity_filter` (Block List) Identity conditions for the data security policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--identity_filter))
- `object_filter` (Block List) Object conditions for the data security policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--object_filter))
- `predefined` (Boolean) Whether the data security policy is predefined.
- `severity` (String) Severity of the data security policy.
- `threshold_filter` (Block List) Threshold condition deciding how many matches raise a violation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--threshold_filter))

<a id="nestedblock--identity_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `identity_filter`

Read-Only:

- `condition` (Block List) Filter condition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--identity_filter--condition))
- `op` (String) Logical operator joining the conditions in this block, AND or OR.

<a id="nestedblock--identity_filter--condition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `identity_filter.condition`

Read-Only:

- `filter_type` (String) Filter type. Valid filter types are SECURITY_IDENTITY_*, SECURITY_GPO_*.
- `relationship` (String) Comparison operator.
- `values` (List of String) Filter values.



<a id="nestedblock--object_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `object_filter`

Read-Only:

- `condition` (Block List) Filter condition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--object_filter--condition))
- `op` (String) Logical operator joining the conditions in this block, AND or OR.

<a id="nestedblock--object_filter--condition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `object_filter.condition`

Read-Only:

- `filter_type` (String) Filter type. Valid filter types are SECURITY_DOCUMENT_*, SECURITY_SNAPPABLE_*.
- `relationship` (String) Comparison operator.
- `values` (List of String) Filter values.



<a id="nestedblock--threshold_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `threshold_filter`

Read-Only:

- `filter_type` (String) Filter type. Valid filter types are SECURITY_DOCUMENT_*, SECURITY_SNAPPABLE_*, SECURITY_IDENTITY_*, SECURITY_GPO_*.
- `relationship` (String) Comparison operator.
- `values` (List of String) Filter values.
